## History

Marshall is mentioned as part of the broader community context when [Anne](../character/anne.md) brings home news about local changes, including the departure of Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and the arrival of the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. He is not directly involved in the events at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepares for and hosts the minister and his wife for tea.
